items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: I had Joe Polizzi on clarinet.

ctx.x: Did they have many piano players in those days? They had a few.

They never had too many of them, though. They had a few of them. But we didn't need no piano. Jacqueline never thought that we could, none did I. I didn't think. In the first place, where we played, we played mostly in the open. And when we played in a place in the hall, so they had pianos. But they were so low that you couldn't tune up with them. You never had enough slide to pull out. And you couldn't transpose enough to put him natural, or put you natural, and him transposed, or him natural, and you…
